# Magic Analytics Plugin

Analytics for the Magic Framework: one `Analytics` facade over a GTM driver on web (GA4 through a first-party gateway path), a Firebase driver on iOS and Android, and a null driver when nothing is configured. Consent for ads is always denied; the package is inert until the host sets its IDs.

**Version:** 1.0.0 · **Dart:** >=3.13.0 · **Flutter:** >=3.47.0

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `flutter test --coverage` | Run the VM tests with coverage |
| `flutter test --platform chrome test/drivers/gtm_web_driver_test.dart` | Run the `@TestOn('browser')` GtmWebDriver tests the VM run skips; run it after any change to the GTM driver |
| `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` | Static analysis |
| `dart format .` | Format all code |
| `flutter pub publish --dry-run` | Pre-publish check |
| `python3 tool/check-docs.py` | Docs structure, links, fragments and ToC anchors; run it after any `doc/` change |
| `dart run magic:dowel plugin:install magic_analytics` | In a consumer app: publish `lib/config/analytics.dart`, inject `AnalyticsServiceProvider` and the `analyticsConfig` factory |

## Architecture

**Pattern**: a facade (`Analytics`) resolving one driver, as Magic's other facades do. Drivers: GTM (web), Firebase (iOS, Android), null (disabled or unconfigured).

```
lib/
├── magic_analytics.dart       # Barrel export, the only public runtime API
├── cli.dart                   # Flutter-free barrel: the dowel provider only
└── src/
    ├── analytics_service_provider.dart # Binds AnalyticsManager, adds the route observer, resets on auth change
    ├── cli/                   # MagicAnalyticsDowelProvider (no commands; plugin:install needs it)
    ├── facades/               # Analytics facade and AnalyticsManager (limits, scrubbing, opt-out, call queue)
    ├── drivers/               # AnalyticsDriver contract; GTM web, Firebase mobile, null; driver_factory* picks one per platform
    ├── observers/             # Route observer feeding page views
    ├── support/               # UrlScrubber
    └── testing/               # FakeAnalytics, bound by Analytics.fake()
install.yaml                   # Plugin manifest: config publish, provider injection, config factory
assets/stubs/install/analytics_config.stub  # analyticsConfig, published into a consumer's lib/config/analytics.dart
example/                       # Magic app: the provider plus event, identify and opt-out buttons
doc/                           # User docs, published by the docs site: getting-started/, basics/, guides/
skills/magic-analytics/        # Agent skill, installed with `npx skills add anilcancakir/magic_analytics`
tool/check-docs.py             # Offline docs gate, run by docs-link-check.yml
```

`driver_factory.dart` is a conditional export keyed on `dart.library.js_interop` (web, wasm included) and `dart.library.io` (native). Never key the web arm on `dart:html`: it is absent under wasm, so a browser would fall through to the Firebase driver.

## Post-Change Checklist

After a source code change, sync **before committing**. A change is not done while one of these is stale:

1. **`CHANGELOG.md`**: Add entry under `[Unreleased]` section
2. **`README.md`, `llms.txt` and the `doc/` pages**: Update if features, API, or usage changes
3. **`skills/magic-analytics/SKILL.md`**: Update when the API, a rule or a gotcha changes; its `version:` moves with the release, and the publish check compares it with the tag
4. **`CLAUDE.md`**: Update the architecture tree when files move

## Development Flow (TDD)

Red, green, refactor for every feature, fix or refactor: no production code without a failing test first. After every change `flutter test` stays green and `flutter analyze` reports zero warnings and errors. Never run `dart format` on files you did not change.

## Testing

- No mocking library: fake through contract inheritance, or `Analytics.fake()`
- Tests mirror `lib/src/` and import from `package:magic_analytics/magic_analytics.dart`; driver tests import `package:magic_analytics/src/drivers/...`, since the barrel does not export the drivers
- `setUp` runs `MagicApp.reset(); Magic.flush();`; `tearDown` calls `Analytics.unfake()` and `MagicRouter.reset()`

## Key Gotchas

| Mistake | Fix |
|---------|-----|
| Initialising Firebase on web | Never; web goes through GTM only |
| Loading GTM on an opted-out device | The GTM driver loads the container lazily on the first send and never while opted out; the consent defaults are pushed before `gtm.js` |
| Granting `ad_storage`, `ad_user_data` or `ad_personalization` | Always denied; no config or call may flip them |
| An analytics call throwing into UI flow | `AnalyticsManager._send` catches and logs every driver error, so a driver may throw; only a GA4 limit violation throws, as an assert in debug |
| An email, token or code in an event param, page location or title | Never send one; the user id is the only identity |
| Relative paths in `pubspec_overrides.yaml` | Use absolute ones; the file is never committed |

## Release

1. Open a `release:` PR that bumps `pubspec.yaml`, `skills/magic-analytics/SKILL.md` and the `Version:` line above, and promotes `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
2. After it merges, tag the merge commit with the bare version (`git tag 1.0.0 <merge-sha> && git push origin 1.0.0`, no `v`). `publish.yml` runs from the tag; the pub.dev Admin tab holds repository `anilcancakir/magic_analytics`, tag pattern `{{version}}` and push events only.
3. A failed `Validate` is fixed forward: delete the tag (`git push --delete origin <tag>` and `git tag -d <tag>`), fix it on a PR and tag the new merge commit. If only `github-release` fails after pub.dev accepted the version, use "Re-run failed jobs" (never "Re-run all jobs"). By hand instead: `gh release create <tag> --title <tag> --verify-tag --notes-file <file>` with `--latest` for a stable tag or `--prerelease` for one with a `-` suffix (as the `github-release` job does), then, for a stable tag only, `gh workflow run dispatch-to-registry.yml --ref <tag>`, because the skipped `registry` job does not resume on its own.

## CI

- `ci.yml`: push/PR → `flutter pub get` → `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos` → `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` → `flutter test --coverage` → the Chrome run of the GTM driver tests → codecov upload
- `changelog.yml`: a PR that changes `lib/`, `install.yaml` or `assets/stubs/` must also change `CHANGELOG.md`; Dependabot, `release:` PRs and the `skip-changelog` label are exempt
- `docs-link-check.yml`: every PR runs `python3 tool/check-docs.py` and an offline lychee pass; Mondays an external-link pass
- `publish.yml`: tag on master → version stamps (tag, pubspec, skill) → analyze, format, test, dry-run, pana 160/160, changelog section → OIDC publish → GitHub Release → registry sync (`dispatch-to-registry.yml`, needs the `REGISTRY_BOT_*` secrets)
- `dependabot-auto-merge.yml`: arms auto-merge for the `minor-and-patch` Dependabot group only
